# EP Energy

> EP Energy Corporation was an independent exploration and production (E&P) company
> developing unconventional onshore oil and natural gas properties in the United States.
> The company filed for Chapter 11 in October 2019, emerged in October 2020, and was
> acquired by Verdun Oil Company II LLC (EnCap Investments) on 30 March 2022. It is no
> longer an operating company and publishes no APIs, SDKs, or developer resources.

*This file was generated by API Evangelist from the public record — EP Energy itself
publishes no llms.txt. Verify current details against the company's own site and filings.*

## Status

- Operating status: acquired / no longer an independent company
- Chapter 11 filed: October 2019; emerged October 2020
- Acquired by: Verdun Oil Company II LLC (EnCap Investments), completed 30 March 2022
- Utah / Uinta assets: divested post-closing under an FTC order
- Developer program: none, at any point on the public record

## Domains

- epenergy.com — the company's own corporate domain. Now 301s to https://verdunoilco.com/
  (the acquirer). /llms.txt and /.well-known/security.txt both return 404.
- ep-energy.com — NOT operated by EP Energy. Listed for sale on the GoDaddy aftermarket;
  every path returns the same 114-byte parked-domain lander shell with HTTP 200. Nothing
  served on this host should be read as an EP Energy artifact.

## API surface

- OpenAPI / Swagger: none published
- GraphQL: none published
- AsyncAPI / webhooks: none published
- MCP server: none published
- A2A agent card: none published
- SDKs / packages: none on npm or PyPI
- /.well-known/ documents: none served (see well-known/ep-energy-well-known.yml)
